function: Random.Next(count) over Skill.GetDecayCandidates (the decay pick in Skill.GiveSkillXP)
description: When a rank-up pushes the player over the skill cap, GiveSkillXP removes a rank from one decay candidate chosen with Random.Next(candidates.Count). GiveSkillXP needs the engine (Tier B), so this records the candidate lists (read from the private GetDecayCandidates) and the same pick expression candidates[Random.Next(candidates.Count)] drawn from a seeded generator.
inputs: The cases of SkillCapRules that have at least two decay candidates and a skill that counts toward the cap; 24 consecutive picks per case from a generator reseeded with 4101 for each case.
rows: at the cap, three decayable skills
at the cap, two skills above their limit
